t3:th_pairing_redirect.text: The iPhone pairing screen loops back to the QR code after the token refresh. Find out why and fix it.
Found it: the refresh handler saved the new token after it redirected, so the pairing screen saw no token and started over. I moved the save before the redirect and added a test for the order.
The redirect fix is in. Run the pairing tests in companion/desktop to confirm it before I commit?
